name: Burdening Edgeplate
description: Hook the upper rim over the foe's blade at the crossguard and hold it for one beat.

name: Sturdy Lightrim
description: Plant the lower rim on the ground to brace the plate against a heavy downward cut.

name: Sturdy Knucklegrip
description: Slide the rim down the foe's blade toward the hilt so the cut loses its force.

name: Lithe Armstrap
description: Step in while the foe's blade is hooked so he cannot withdraw it.

name: Levering Nudge
description: Hold qi in the rim so the hooked blade stays locked while the foe struggles to pull free.

name: Rushing Roundface
description: Crush the dome down on the foe's trapped hand with qi packed behind the blow.

name: Peltabarrier
description: Pivot the plate on the fist so its face always turns to the foe's blade.

name: Dense Bucklerredge
description: Roll the wrist over to carry a cut across the plate and off its far side.

name: Punchboss Hammerfall
description: Spin the plate a half turn so the rim slices across the foe's forearm.

name: Resolute Smallface
description: Turn the plate against the direction of the cut to blunt its force.

name: Prowling Punchblock
description: Slide on the ball of the lead foot to turn the whole body with the plate.

name: Rooted Centergrip
description: Whirl the plate in small circles before the body with qi so that cuts and thrown blades are turned.

name: Umboscorer
description: Finish a turned parry by driving the spinning rim into the foe's ribs with qi.

name: Peltascreen
description: Draw the foe's blade toward the body by the hooked rim until the point is out of line.

name: Layered Bucklerredge
description: Catch an edge in the angle between plate and forearm and hold it still.

name: Parryscreen
description: Lever the foe's sword arm outward using the plate edge as a fulcrum against his wrist.

name: Keen Umbo
description: Jab upward under the foe's chin as the hooked blade pulls his body forward.

name: Coasting Snapblock
description: Step wide of the trapped blade so only the foe's free hand can still reach.

name: Layered Punchboss
description: Let the blade go with a sudden rap that sends it spinning off line.

name: Dabbarrier
description: Lock the hook with a pulse of qi so the caught blade cannot be twisted free.

name: Clutching Tuckin
description: Wrench the hooked blade from the foe's grip with a qi-backed pull of the rim.

name: Parry Flog
description: Rap the foe's blade twice with an uneven beat so his next stroke comes late.

name: Targehasp
description: Bring the plate back a fraction after the foe expects it so his cut lands short.

name: Harsh Punchblock
description: Fake a dome punch to the face and drop the plate to meet the cut that follows.

name: Clutching Dab
description: Lower the plate as though tired to lure a high cut and then lift it again to catch the blade.

name: Parryhurdle
description: Step across the foe's rhythm on the off-beat so his stroke has no target.

name: Shielding Smallface
description: Slap the foe's sword hand with the rim to clear the line for the next blow.

name: Lassoing Armstrap
description: Rap with qi in the plate to jar the foe's arm out of its swing.

name: Dense Knucklegrip
description: Hold qi still until the moment of the cut and release it into a sharp parry.

name: Bold Snapblock
description: Press the dome against the foe's chest and push steadily with qi until he loses his footing.

name: Stalwart Edgeplate
description: Hold the plate under a steady stream of qi until the arm no longer tires.

name: Clayumbo
description: Meet a cut with a plate whose qi rings back against the edge.

name: Roundface Thwack
description: Swing the dome back with qi in it so a blow is answered at once.

name: Brasstarge
description: Spread qi evenly so the plate takes a blow anywhere on its face.

name: Grim Nudge
description: Rake the hardened rim down the length of the foe's forearm.

name: Clay Dab
description: Stride forward behind the plate with qi settled in the guard arm.

name: Candor Umbo
description: Feel through the grip how much force a blow carries before it lands.

name: Clay Bucklerredge
description: Harden the plate face with qi and brace into the foe's heaviest cut.

name: Ember Parry
description: Smash the dome through the foe's guard with qi packed behind the punch.

name: Humpelta
description: Turn a cut with the hardened rim and strike back along the same line.

name: Unmoving Lightrim
description: Roll the shoulder forward under the plate so the blow slides over the back.

name: Brassumbo
description: Drop into a forward roll with the plate over the head to pass under a cut.

name: Bracing Umbo
description: Turn the back to a flank attack and let the plate swing round to catch it.

name: Lithe Snapblock
description: Circle the foe at the edge of his reach with the plate always facing him.

name: Brawnumbo
description: Come up from a crouch and strike the foe's knee with the rim.

name: Draught Knucklegrip
description: Roll clear of a falling blow and regain the feet with the plate raised.

name: Shard Armstrap
description: Link a roll and a turn and a rise under qi so that cover never breaks between them.

name: Peltascorer
description: Roll under a cut and drive the qi-backed dome up into the foe's belly.

name: Brass Punchboss
description: Keep the plate forward of the sword hand so one arm guards while the other cuts.

name: Brassparry
description: Meet a cut with the plate and answer with the sword in the same breath.

name: Poiseumbo
description: Sweep the plate across the foe's blade to clear the line for a thrust from the sword hand.

name: Rill Nudge
description: Shift the weight from the guard foot to the sword foot as plate and blade trade the lead.

name: Binding Parry
description: Lock the foe's blade with the plate while the sword hand strikes free.

name: Brass Edgeplate
description: Carry qi from the sword arm to the plate arm so the guard holds while the sword strikes.

name: Rude Tuckin
description: Lead with the plate to cover the entry and thrust past its edge with qi at the point.

name: Savage Roundface
description: Gather the wrist back and release a single sharp rap on the foe's blade.

name: Resolute Lightrim
description: Let the plate spring back from a blow and return to centre in one motion.

name: Static Centergrip
description: Bundle qi in the rim and tap the foe's knuckles hard enough to numb them.

name: Haze Edgeplate
description: Clear two stabs at once with a crosswise sweep of the plate.

name: Peltabuckle
description: Hold qi and breath together behind the plate through a long assault.

name: Brawn Dab
description: Draw the feet together and step wide so the next rap lands from a fresh angle.

name: Parryslap
description: Store qi in the wrist through three parries and release it all in one rap.

name: Levering Tuckin
description: Touch the rim to the foe's wrist with qi to dull his grip for a moment.

name: Hazepelta
description: Chain small raps along a flurry of cuts so that each one turns a blade.

name: Umboscreen
description: Keep the plate within an inch of the body so a cut finds no room to build force.

name: Armstrap Prop
description: Rap a blade aside with a tiny motion of the wrist when there is no room to swing.

name: Smallface Swat
description: Jab the dome out and back from the shoulder with no wind-up.

name: Umbostalk
description: Squeeze past the foe's guard with a heel and toe step that keeps the plate between you.

name: Bold Dab
description: Compress qi into the dome and punch from a hand's breadth for a hard knock.

name: Peltaprop
description: Keep a qi-backed screen over chest and arms while the foe crowds in.
